Cc: Aurora Health Legal <legal@aurorahealth.com>, Aurora Health Procurement <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: TIA requirements and evidence ask for onboarding

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turn so far. Attached is our TIA requirements spreadsheet and a short requirements PDF (Aurora_TIA_requirements_v2.pdf). High level asks from our side:

- Full subprocessor map with data flow lines and retention commitments
- Evidence that key subprocessors support EU-residency fallback for personenbezogene Daten
- Confirmation of HSM/KMS custody model and attestation (we typically ask for a key custody diagram + KMS vendor SOC2 or equivalent)
- Token-level retention and sample audit logs for request routing (last 90 days)

We have a strict procurement gating process and will either accept the TIA evidence set or require a signed UK addendum + IDTA bridge. Can Redwood provide an accelerated evidence gate (limited list + temporary onshore cache) while legal finalises the UK Addendum?

Would like to schedule a 30-min sync early next week to confirm the exact evidence artifacts and timeline.

Attachment: Aurora_TIA_requirements_v2.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Security - Aurora Health
security@aurorahealth.com

Subject: Re: TIA requirements and evidence ask for onboarding

Hi Samira —

Thanks for sending the TIA doc. We can provision an "accelerated evidence gate" while the full UK Addendum is finalized. Proposed approach:

1) Immediate deliverables (within 5 business days):
   - Subprocessor map extract (redwood_subprocessor_map.csv) limited to processors touching Aurora tenant data
   - Sample audit logs (anonymized) showing routing and token retention windows
   - High-level KMS custody diagram + vendor attestation summary (no secrets)

2) Conditional mitigations (temporary, 30-day window):
   - Onshore cache enabled for EU traffic routes where feasible
   - Contractual bridge letter (executed between procurement teams) that binds Redwood to produce full TIA artifacts when available

3) Finalization: UK Addendum / IDTA to replace the accelerated gate within 30 calendar days once legal signoff is complete.

Laura, would you be able to confirm whether a bridge letter + the subprocessor extract is acceptable from a legal/compliance point of view? Jordan / Kimberly, please confirm we can enable the onshore cache for Aurora's tenant and scope the sample logs.

Happy to hop on a quick call Monday (Sep 27) morning PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Samira / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear asks. From Legal's perspective:

- Subprocessor map: we can provide a filtered CSV (redwood_subprocessor_map.csv) that lists processors, roles, and whether they persist logs. We cannot publish internal architecture diagrams that contain credentials. The KMS custody diagram will be a vendor-level diagram + statement (we'll attach the vendor SOC2 summary).

- Audit logs: we can provide anonymized samples and an explanation of retention windows. Operationally, full raw logs are excluded for security reasons but we will provide hashes/timestamps and the query criteria used.

- UK Addendum / IDTA: legal is comfortable with a bridge-letter approach to enable provisioning as long as the bridge letter includes a commitment to execute the UK Addendum within 30 days and a rollback/cutover plan if evidence cannot be delivered. We will draft the bridge letter and the temporary clause.

Notes and limitations:
1) We cannot commit to third-party HSM key material transfer; we can attest to custody model and provide vendor attestations.
2) Onshore caching is possible in a limited footprint; ops needs time to schedule the tenant-specific configuration.

Next steps (legal ops):
- I'll draft a short bridge letter and upload to the Drive link (see related_links).
- Marissa / Jordan: please confirm ops ETA.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Legal — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Marissa / Laura —

Operational ETA: we can enable onshore caching for Aurora's tenant as an isolated feature flag by Sep 30 (target). Ops will need a maintenance window (30 minutes) and a list of endpoint prefixes. Kimberly, can you confirm whether the sample logs requested can be generated by Sep 29?

Procurement note: Aurora's procurement team asked whether we can offer an "accelerated evidence gate" as a standard option for high-value regulated customers. Proposal for internal signoff:

- Offer accelerated gate (30-day tempo) with delivered artifacts: filtered subprocessor CSV, anonymized sample logs, KMS vendor attestation, and bridge letter from legal.
- Mark as "temporary" in console with an expiration timestamp and auto-rollback if UK Addendum not executed.
- Require procurement signature + PO receipt to enable feature.

Can Legal confirm the bridge letter language will allow the automated rollback? If yes, I'll prepare the internal PRD and procurement checklist so Revenue Ops can process the PO quickly.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
